summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a change in the effective date of its previously announced 1-for-50 reverse share split from September 8 to September 9, 2026. The reverse split combines 50 ordinary shares into one, reducing outstanding shares from 77,492,393 to approximately 1,549,848. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions of 0.5 or higher round up, lower fractions are cancelled. Alpha Compute's shares will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol ALP with a new CUSIP. The reverse split aims to maintain compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
